name: League Champion
summary:
League Champion is a free online football (soccer) manager game for private leagues. One player creates a league and invites friends; empty slots can be filled with computer-controlled teams. Leagues have 6 to 20 teams and play a double round-robin season, or a cup mode with groups and knockout rounds from 12 teams upwards. All players and clubs are fictional.

Matches are simulated automatically, one matchday per night, so nobody has to be online at the same time. Managers set the line-up, formation and tactical style, plan training, bid in a sealed-bid transfer market without displayed market values, and develop youth players between seasons. The game is in German and runs in the web browser and as an app for Android and iPhone.
